def evolved_p91(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i, j] = (-1)^(i + j)
    # This is a checkerboard pattern of +1/-1 based solely on the sum of
    # row index i and column index j (position-based, not value-based).
    # No collective communication is required since it can be computed
    # locally and identically on every rank.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    ii = idx.view(N, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N)
    parity = (ii + jj) % 2  # 0 for even parity, 1 for odd parity
    result = 1 - 2 * parity  # +1 when parity==0, -1 when parity==1
    return result.to(x.dtype).contiguous()
